Name: Anointing Oil Spikenard Magdalena Anointing Oil Israel
Natural: Magdalena Spikenard Anointing Oil This oil was produced according to the exact ingredients that were used in the 1st century B.C. The formula consists of myrrh, nard, cinnamon, iris, sunbul oil, perfume oil. The name spikenard is mentioned in Matthew 26:7
